lines.en: Karin and I meet up at our usual park but she decides against running today due to all of the ice on the ground.
lines.zh: 我和 Karin 在老地方那个公园碰面，但因为地上全是冰，她今天决定不跑了。

lines.en: She talks about how she normally signs up for a gym membership in the winter for this exact reason, but then begins to panic once I ask what gym she goes to.
lines.zh: 她说起自己冬天通常会为此办张健身卡，可我一问她去的是哪家健身房，她就开始慌了。

lines.en: I guess she's embarrassed about being seen there, but she exercises in front of me all the time so I'm not really sure what her deal is.
lines.zh: 我猜她是不好意思被人看见在那儿，可她在我面前锻炼也不是一次两次了，我真搞不懂她在别扭什么。

lines.en: Regardless, we spend the afternoon under a gazebo- hiding behind its pillars each time the wind blows.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我们在凉亭里待了一下午——每次起风就躲到柱子后面。

lines.en: She does this thing where she holds on to her ponytail every time a large gust comes around and, despite it being a little pointless in my view, it's definitely cute.
lines.zh: 每次刮大风她都会按住自己的马尾，虽然我觉得这有点毫无意义，但确实很可爱。

lines.en: But she's become sort of synonymous with cute behavior at this point, so that shouldn't really come as any surprise.
lines.zh: 不过到这地步，她基本已经和「可爱」画上等号了，所以也不该觉得意外。

lines.en: Slowly but surely, I can feel Karin becoming a little more comfortable with me.
lines.zh: 缓慢但确实地，我能感觉到 Karin 跟我在一起时自在了些。

lines.en: Don't get me wrong, she's still nowhere near the level of going out on dates or anything like that, but-
lines.zh: 别误会，她离能一起出去约会什么的还差得远，但是——

lines.en: Well, let's just say that it's very easy to tell she likes being around me.
lines.zh: 好吧，这么说吧，谁都看得出来她喜欢和我在一起。

lines.en: Why she likes that, I have no idea. But it doesn't change the fact that she does.
lines.zh: 她为什么喜欢，我毫无头绪。但这并不改变她确实喜欢这个事实。

lines.en: So I will continue being the horrible cynic I am as it has yet to negatively impact the growing bond between the two of us.
lines.zh: 所以我会继续做我这个糟糕的愤世嫉俗者——反正它至今没对我们之间越来越深的关系造成什么负面影响。
